mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT PRD_LAYER_PARAM.PROD_STYLE id, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.PROD_STYLE text, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID object FROM PRD_LAYER_PARAM WHERE P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND PRD_LAYER_PARAM.PROD_STYLE LIKE concat('%',concat(#{search},'%'))
select FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE, FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE from FIN_PRODUCT where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select FCI.CASH_ID cashId, FCI.FEE_ID feeId, MF.FEE_TYPE feeType, FCCR.BASIS basis, FCCR.BASE_TYPE basicBill, FFCRU.FIRST_BASE_TYPE firstBaseType, FCPR.END_TDAY_RULE calcFeeTradeRule, FCPR.PAY_TDAY_RULE payFeeTradeRule, FCPR.PAY_CYCLE payFeeRule, FCPR.EFF_DATE effDate, FFCRU.F_ACCR_DATE provisionFirstDay, FFCRU.ACCR_TDAY_RULE accrTdayRule, FCCR.YIELD * 100 feeRate, FCCR.BASE_DATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, FFCRU.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FCPR.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstCalEndDate, MF.CHARGE_TYPE chargeType, PLP.FINPROD_ID prodStyle, FP.VDATE vdate, FP.MDATE mdate, FP.LIQUIDATION_DATE liquidationDate, FP.CALENDAR_ID dealCalId, FP.PROFIT_TYPE profitType from FIN_CASH_INFO FCI, MST_FEEINFO MF, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE FCCR, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE FFCRU, FIN_PRODUCT FP left join prd_layer_param PLP on FP.FINPROD_ID = PLP.FINPROD_ID WHERE FCI.FEE_ID = MF.FEE_ID and FCI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID and FCI.CASH_ID = FCCR.CASH_ID
and FCI.CASH_ID = FCPR.CASH_ID
and FCI.CASH_ID = FFCRU.CASH_ID
and (FCI.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} or PLP.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}) and FCI.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} and MF.FEE_TYPE in (#{feeTypeTrust}, #{feeTypeFix}, #{feeTypeSale}, #{feeTypeOthSale}, #{feeTypeThService},#{feeTypeInvest}) and FCI.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} and FCPR.EFF_DATE = FCCR.EFF_DATE and FCPR.EFF_DATE = FFCRU.EFF_DATE and FCPR.EFF_DATE = (select max(cpr.eff_date) from FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE cpr where cpr.cash_id = FCI.cash_id)
select b.* from FIN_PRODUCT a inner join FIN_PRODUCT b on a.FINPROD_ID = b.P_FINPROD_ID where a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
